# Biryani Grill

> Biryani Grill is an Indian restaurant located at 42010 Village Center Plaza #170, Stone Ridge, VA 20105, offering authentic Indian flavors paired with Virginia hospitality.

## Services
### Signature Biryanis
- Mutton Biryani (Goat)
- Chicken Dum Biryani
- Paneer Biryani

### Tandoor Specialties
- Paneer Tikka
- Fish Tikka
- Hariyali Chicken

### Curries & Specialties
- Lababdar Paneer
- Chicken Tikka Masala
- Goat Curry

### Signature
- Mutton Biryani (Goat)
- Chicken Dum Biryani
